campaign.surfaceSet: R9-R05 frozen split integration: all 16 source-audit feature definitions, linked requirement parent cases and PDP0-501 crosswalk traces; retained packet capabilities checked through the pinned predecessor chain.

verifiedFacts.detail: R9-R05 freeze, bundle, repair map, rebuild verification, seven source preimages and all four selected postimages match their recorded SHA-256 pins. Frozen R04 actual H review hashes locally to 301b8fdc…0f2bac3.

All 16 requested audit IDs resolve to the expected capability IDs, parent cases and crosswalk evidence. The candidate has 487 capabilities, 38 requirements, 52 feature leaf cases and 54 feature parent cases. All 501 crosswalk rows are unique with no missing or unexpected IDs; all 16 reviewed rows remain BOUND_EXISTING. Denominators remain 54 identities, 216 cells and 462 historical owner rows; the retained projection stays at 248 operations.

R05 preserves the prior repairs. All 34 F-06 parent cases and all 54 feature parent cases match linked leaf polarity, given, when and then exactly, including EDIT-024 two-parent mapping. R05 changes only the GEN-024 positive then field and its linked positive parent then versus R04.

GEN-024 successOutputs and success observableContract.resultVariants contain only LICENSE_POLICY_AXIS_RECORDED and PLACEMENT_AXIS_RECORDED. nonSuccessOutputs separately contains REJECTED, UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and UNAVAILABLE. Missing, stale or ambiguous evidence maps to UNKNOWN_OUTCOME; REJECTED is limited to explicit invalid, unsupported or denied requests. Negative leaf/parent then fields match exactly.

All pinned references in the R02, R03, R04 and R05 freeze records match local hashes, including each historical freeze, bundle, H review, selected postimage/preimage, operation ledger/schema and retained projection. R05 crosswalk postimage is byte-identical to R04/R03. The R05 candidate and rebuild records both say canonicalApply NONE and phaseStatusEffect NONE.

Although the structured nonSuccessOutputs map missing/stale/ambiguous evidence only to UNKNOWN_OUTCOME, semanticOutcomeContract.conditions and the negative acceptance-case given still say that evidence “stays UNKNOWN” or “returns UNKNOWN.” The definition therefore retains a second, undefined outcome token for the same condition; see F-09.

Live PDP-0 remains IN_PROGRESS with 9 stale and 21 missing source pins of 188 and 0 outstandingMeaningIds. Owner decision, root adoption, schema registration and apply authorization remain unset. Currentness was observed only; no status refresh was performed.

findings.location: R05 capabilities postimage ownerDefinition.semanticOutcomeContract.conditions and MEDIA-P0-COHORT02-AUD-GEN-024-LEAF-NEG given; corresponding linked requirement parent negative case preserves the same case text/context.
findings.finding: Structured nonSuccessOutputs routes missing, stale or ambiguous evidence to UNKNOWN_OUTCOME only, and REJECTED is correctly restricted to explicit invalid, unsupported or denied requests. But semanticOutcomeContract.conditions says “missing/stale evidence stays UNKNOWN,” and the negative case given says missing/stale/ambiguous evidence “returns UNKNOWN” and “stays UNKNOWN.” UNKNOWN is not a defined nonSuccessOutputs key and conflicts with the requested single UNKNOWN_OUTCOME token.
findings.repair: Replace those residual UNKNOWN outcome labels in semanticOutcomeContract.conditions and the linked negative acceptance-case given with UNKNOWN_OUTCOME. Preserve the structured output partition and exact leaf/parent polarity, given, when and then parity.
findings.predecessor: R9-R05 frozen integrated candidate; R04 F-08 is otherwise repaired by separating success variants from non-success outputs.
findings.acceptanceCriterion: Every semantic statement for missing, stale or ambiguous evidence names only UNKNOWN_OUTCOME; nonSuccessOutputs remains the sole structured location for UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and UNAVAILABLE; REJECTED remains explicit invalid/unsupported/denied only; negative leaf and parent match exactly.
findings.nextLegalAction: Repair only the GEN-024 semanticOutcomeContract condition and linked negative case wording in the candidate leaf and parent, then submit a new frozen cut for independent review. No canonical apply or phase-status change.
